items.title: Harrison Barnes Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: He was playing with Allen, too. He was one of the fellas playing with Allen at that time.

ctx.x: You remember Frankie Doosen ever went down in the country that way? Did you work with him?
He was playing with Allen, too. He was one of the fellas playing with Allen at that time.
Did he ever come down there in a dance band or anything?
